top_signals.title: Luxfer Enters Into Agreement to Be Acquired for $17.37 Per Share in All-Cash Transaction
top_signals.summary: Luxfer Holdings PLC (NYSE: LXFR), a global industrial company innovating niche applications in materials engineering, today announced that it has entered into a definitive agreement to be acquired by affiliates of Wynnchurch Capital, L.P. (“Wynnchurch”) in an all-cash transaction. This press release features multimedia.
